call_points.text: FY27 company-level volume growth targeted at ~15%, with ATBS at 15% annually for three years.
ATBS demand softened from October 2025 but has recovered; 15-20% volume growth expected in FY27.
IBB volume fell ~20% in FY26 due to raw material shortage from the Iran war; now resolved.
Antioxidants revenue grew 15% in FY26 despite Chinese undercutting; ADD application rejected and reapplied.
Board recommended dividend of ₹8.50 per share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval.
Antioxidant ADD decision expected in 6-9 months; Chinese suppliers continue aggressive pricing.
